description: This file defines the AspectRatioTrigger class, a custom XAML trigger for UI state management based on aspect ratio of a FrameworkElement, with configurable numerator aspect, threshold, and equality condition.

classes.name: Aspect
classes.description: Enumeration for specifying whether height or width is used as numerator in aspect ratio calculation.

classes.name: AspectRatioTrigger
classes.description: A custom trigger class that activates based on the aspect ratio of a FrameworkElement.

methods.name: AspectRatioTrigger
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the trigger and sets it inactive.

methods.name: OnSourcePropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the Source property, updating event subscriptions.

methods.name: RegisterSizeChanged
methods.description: Subscribes to SizeChanged event of the source element.

methods.name: UnregisterSizeChanged
methods.description: Unsubscribes from SizeChanged event of the element.

methods.name: OnSizeChanged
methods.description: Event handler for size changes, triggers aspect ratio evaluation.

methods.name: UpdateIsActive
methods.description: Calculates the aspect ratio and updates the trigger's active state based on threshold and equality condition.
